draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 231st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 32nd of 32 at WR. He went 244th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: broad jump (81st percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (1st percentile), three-cone (18th percentile). College production: 504 receiving yards in 2022, 28th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 27 career games and 1 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), team target share 1.0% (8th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 51 receiving yards against a median of 346, below the norm.
